run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the missing number from an array of n consecutive integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of the missing number algorithm
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a cumulative sum approach to find the missing number in a sequence
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that computes the missing number by tracking the difference between expected and actual values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support finding missing numbers in sequences that start from values other than 1
